common: This is an experimental educational collection. A retained graphic is not evidence of tactile recognition, a learning benefit, universal suitability or BANA certification.
Physical printing/embossing calibration, tactile proofreading, device/page fit and learner evaluation remain pending. Screen viewing and nominal geometry checks do not establish physical readability.
Nominal canvases vary and some are large. Automatic fit-to-page changes line widths, dots and clearances; evaluate any scaled output on the intended medium.

The SVGs contain no visible text or Braille. Supply accessible titles, orientation, labels, keys, scale/context and model explanations as appropriate. Existing companion keys and briefs are linked; where no standalone key exists, one still needs to be prepared for delivery.
Index dots can be ordinary line samples rather than semantic points. ViewPlus grey/height roles are provisional and do not establish calibrated raised heights.
Models simplify anatomy, geometry, geography, counts, material roles and natural proportions. Consult each item’s notes and source/key before using it to teach a factual relationship.

856 meanings retain their earlier production review records. The final 42 were kept by the human, with nonblocking BANA-informed comments; they did not all pass the earlier independent approval process. These histories are distinguished in the catalogue.
The curriculum audit covered a dated remaining subset, not every retained item. Membership is not a claim that a syllabus requires this exact diagram.

Sources have different provenance and usage terms. No blanket licence, permission to redistribute third-party sources, or endorsement by APH, BTactile, BANA or curriculum bodies is claimed. Consult the item records for restrictions.

notes.text: The isolated large inner circle shares the unfilled circular style used for atoms and is visually prominent. notes.text: The ring and outward bonds meet atom-circle outlines deliberately. notes.topic: nominal page size with transform scope
notes.text: XML roots declare500x300mm(handprints),440x340mm(footprints),360x470mm(bones), matching viewBox extents. No transform attributes occur anywhere in these nine exported SVGs; measured nominal stroke/dot sizes therefore have no intervening SVG transform scale. These canvases exceed the reference standard-page dimensions; no actual trimming, placement or device-fit test was performed.
notes.suggested_human_check: Choose the physical delivery format and leave accessible title/key/margin space. Check reach and handling across the large arrays; resizing changes small gaps and line/dot properties. These are not natural body sizes, proved minima or fit approvals.

notes.text: Fingers/toes point up, but no top mark or side labels are printed. The key assigns page-left/page-right to left/right CONTACT IMPRESSIONS, thumbs/big toes inward; it separately names the bone plan a left PALMAR projection with thumb page-left. Side naming cannot be transferred between the diagrams without their stated view convention.
notes.suggested_human_check: Give accessible left/right, top and impression-versus-palmar identification before use, and verify intended side/view labeling during human anatomical review. Ask the learner to locate the thumb/big-toe side without treating page direction alone as an anatomical rule.

notes.text: No direct digit, patch or bone labels appear. The companion names structures and explains cropped/omitted features; long positional descriptions can make it difficult to keep a finger on the corresponding feature.
notes.suggested_human_check: Provide an accessible companion whose names and positional instructions map unambiguously to the drawing. Check the learner can retain place when reading it, especially across five ray chains and the wrist rows; no braille/audio label implementation has been assessed.

notes.topic: nominal line width and provisional relief
notes.text: Swell is BLACK continuous and ViewPlus GREY continuous; both have literal1.4 stroke-width. Index circle radius is0.6, hence1.2 nominal mm diameter under the matching root/viewBox units and absent transforms. Colour is a screen style, not established tactile contrast, pressure, tissue or front/back height.
notes.suggested_human_check: Inspect physical line/dot heights, widths and continuity at delivery scale. Do not infer calibrated pressure/skin/bone depth or physical readability from grey/black rendering or height-role metadata.

notes.text: Index dots form outlines. They do not represent skin pores, pressure samples, braille, extra digits or individual bones. A closed loop or linked chain is the teaching element, rather than each sampling dot.
notes.suggested_human_check: Teach line-carrier versus anatomical element and check line following through clusters/nearby loops. Do not automatically impose semantic point-symbol dimensions on each ordinary contour dot, or count carrier dots as structures.

notes.text: Rounded shaft capsules repeat along five separated chains; the long palm element uses similar styling to the shorter finger elements, with no printed division or labels. The thumb chain has fewer elements.
notes.suggested_human_check: Use the companion to identify metacarpal then phalanges along each ray, and check learners do not count the metacarpal as an extra phalanx. Declared counts are key information, not a count of sampling dots or an independent anatomical certification here.

notes.topic: crowded wrist and named carpal mapping
notes.text: Angular wrist outlines form two rows, with closely approaching distal neighbors while spaces between ray elements are enlarged. Uniform line weight does not identify the named carpal bones.
notes.suggested_human_check: Trace each wrist boundary on a specimen and map the companion names without losing place or jumping to a neighboring polygon. Check relative grouping and declared supports during human anatomy review; enlarged gaps and polygon shapes are not normal measured joint spaces or exact cortex.

notes.text: The small rounded outline at the lower-right wrist overlaps a posterior polygon; the front outline interrupts part of the rear border. The key names this pisiform/triquetrum depth convention, but no printed depth label or differentiated texture establishes it by itself.
notes.suggested_human_check: Physically test whether the learner perceives a front bone covering another, rather than a hole, extra digit or merged loop. Explain the mask explicitly; masking and screen greyness alone do not establish tactile depth.

notes.topic: regional cage/pelvis shapes versus detailed bones

notes.text: The central carrier is visibly thicker and crosses the cage envelope before continuing through the lumbar gap into the sacral region. Its key meaning is BONY spinal-column position, not spinal cord, sternum, a ruler or a contour split.
notes.suggested_human_check: Check the learner can follow and name this carrier across all media and through the intersections. Do not assume a screen width cue persists physically or that the straight carrier measures a normal spinal curve.

notes.text: Lower hip-wing and central sacral contours approach/intersect at upper pelvic junctions; the central carrier crosses the sacral top and ends inside it, while a separate short coccygeal continuation leaves the lower tip. Several line roles share these junctions.
notes.suggested_human_check: On a specimen, trace each hip summary, sacrum and coccygeal continuation without jumping at the junctions or treating overlap as a hole/fracture. Exact anatomical borders and numerical clearances were not assessed.
